parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID per logical submit, 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters (missing is 400 idempotency-key-required, malformed is 400 idempotency-key-invalid). A key is global and kept for 24 hours; the same key with the same method, path and body replays the stored answer with Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with anything else is 409 idempotency-key-reused.
